description: A closed-end motor vehicle lease with its federal Consumer Leasing Act disclosures

form_number.description: The form number printed in the header, e.g. 'HFS-UCL-FL-e-14 1/21'

lease_date.description: The Lease Date at the top of page 1, as YYYY-MM-DD

parties.description: The parties named in the header boxes on page 1

lessor_name.description: The lessor (dealer) name from 'Lessor Name and Business Address'

lessor_address.description: The lessor's business address, street, city, state and ZIP on one line

lessee_name.description: The lessee's name from 'Lessee Name and Address'

lessee_address.description: The lessee's address, street, city, state and ZIP on one line

co_lessee_name.description: The co-lessee's name, or null if there is none

assignee.description: The assignee the lease is assigned to (e.g. a lease trust), if the assignment box is checked

vehicle.description: The leased vehicle, from Item 1 'The Vehicle'

condition.description: New or Used, as printed in the New/Used column

odometer.description: The odometer reading at delivery, in miles

disclosures.description: The Consumer Leasing Act disclosure boxes, Items 2 to 5

amount_due_at_signing.description: Item 2, Amount Due at Lease Signing or Delivery, in dollars

first_monthly_payment.description: Item 3A, the first monthly payment amount, in dollars

first_payment_due_date.description: Item 3A, the date the first monthly payment is due, as YYYY-MM-DD

number_of_following_payments.description: Item 3A, the number of monthly payments that follow the first

following_payment_amount.description: Item 3A, the amount of each following monthly payment, in dollars

payment_due_day.description: Item 3A, the day of each month the payments are due, as written (e.g. '3rd')

total_of_scheduled_payments.description: Item 3C, the total of scheduled payments, in dollars

other_charges_total.description: Item 4D, total of other charges not part of the scheduled payment, in dollars

disposition_fee.description: Item 4A, the turn-in (disposition) fee if the vehicle is not purchased, in dollars

total_of_payments.description: Item 5, Total of Payments, in dollars

payment_calculation.description: Item 7, how the scheduled payment is determined

agreed_value_of_vehicle.description: Item 7A, the agreed upon value of the Vehicle printed in parentheses, in dollars

gross_capitalized_cost.description: Item 7A, gross capitalized cost, in dollars

capitalized_cost_reduction.description: Item 7B, capitalized cost reduction, in dollars

adjusted_capitalized_cost.description: Item 7C, adjusted capitalized cost, in dollars

residual_value.description: Item 7D, residual value of the Vehicle at the end of the lease, in dollars

depreciation_and_amortized_amounts.description: Item 7E, depreciation and any amortized amounts, in dollars

total_of_base_scheduled_payments.description: Item 7G, total of base scheduled payments, in dollars

number_of_payments.description: Item 7H, the number of lease payments

base_scheduled_payment.description: Item 7I, base scheduled payment, in dollars

sales_use_tax.description: Item 7J, sales/use tax per payment, in dollars

total_scheduled_payment.description: Item 7M, Total Scheduled Payment (the monthly payment including tax), in dollars

amount_due_itemization.description: Item 6A, itemization of the amount due at lease signing or delivery

capitalized_cost_reduction_cash.description: 6A1, capitalized cost reduction paid in cash, in dollars

sales_tax_on_cash.description: 6A1, sales/use tax on the amount paid in cash, in dollars

license_and_registration_fees.description: 6A8, license and registration fees, in dollars

other_items.description: Lines 6A10 to 6A12, the write-in items with an amount (skip lines marked N/A)

description.description: The description written on the line

end_of_lease.description: Excess wear, mileage and purchase option terms, Items 8 and 9

mileage_allowance_per_year.description: Item 8, miles per year allowed before excess mileage charges

excess_mileage_rate.description: Item 8, charge per mile over the allowance, in dollars

purchase_option_price.description: Item 9, the price to purchase the Vehicle at the end of the lease term, in dollars

purchase_option_fee.description: Item 9, the purchase option fee, in dollars

lease_term_months.description: Item 20B, the scheduled lease term in months

insurance.description: Item 19, types and amounts of required insurance coverage, and the lessee's insurer

bodily_injury_per_person.description: Minimum bodily injury liability per person, in dollars

bodily_injury_per_accident.description: Minimum bodily injury liability per accident, in dollars

property_damage_per_accident.description: Minimum property damage liability per accident, in dollars

maximum_deductible.description: Maximum deductible for collision, fire, theft and comprehensive coverage, in dollars
